title: I built CouchLab, a virtual game shelf for AI-made games. Submit yours for free!
author: Sudden_Network621
selftext:
I've been building games with AI lately, and one thing I've realized is that making a playable prototype is getting easier. Finding people who actually play it and give useful feedback? Not so much.

So I built **CouchLab**.

It's a virtual game shelf where players can discover games, pick a cover, and play directly on a TV. No downloads needed for supported browser games.

But the bigger idea is **playtesting**.

I want CouchLab to help developers get real players, collect useful feedback, understand where people quit, and improve their games before releasing them.

I've added two of my own games to get things started. Now I want to open the shelf to other creators.

**You can submit your game completely free.** No fees, no exclusivity. Just bring something playable.

I'm starting from zero, so I can't promise thousands of players. But hopefully we can build something useful together.

**Built with AI. Directed by humans. Shaped by players.**

🎮 [https://couchlab.base44.app/](https://couchlab.base44.app/)

I've attached a short trailer showing how it works!

**What would you want from a platform like this?** What kind of playtesting data would actually help you improve your game?
